### context: full
CASTING COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  subtype=hpdc  [hpdc: thin-wall aluminium at 100,000/yr — HPDC gives the lowest piece cost and best surface finish once the die is amortised [pressure-tight, tolerance class, safety-critical assumed — confirm before quoting] — deterministic, use verbatim]
  yieldFraction=0.65  [hpdc yield band 0.55–0.75, midpoint — deterministic, use verbatim]
  netWeightKg=2.8  [1037 cm³ × 0.0027 kg/cm³ (aluminium, confirmed by engineer) — deterministic, use verbatim]
  cycleTimeHpdcSec=54  [45 + 3 × 3.0 mm mean wall — deterministic, use verbatim]
  dieMouldCostGBP=118000  [OCCT parametric hpdc tooling estimate — deterministic, use verbatim]
  dieMouldLife=150000  [hpdc tool life band — deterministic, use verbatim]
  cavities=1  [2.80 kg > 1 kg → single cavity — deterministic, use verbatim]
